title: urnetwork / proxy test (shared)
description: A shared copy of the proxy test dashboard, over all countries and with fixed queries. The proxy test runner measures hosted proxies on main the way a customer sees them. As a Pro test account it creates a hosted proxy in a country, requests cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace through it, opens a random well-known site through it in a fresh headless Chrome, and removes it, over every available country in a shuffled round-robin. setup is the create call to the first successful request through the proxy; connect is Chrome's navigation start to the page's first byte; load is navigation start to loadEventEnd. Percentiles come from the runner's in-memory windows (1 h for all countries, 24 h per country), which start empty after a restart. Counters are read with increase(), which absorbs restarts, and every query deduplicates with max, so a duplicate scrape or a second host never double-counts. The providers section shows how many providers each country has in the public provider-locations list, the list the apps' location picker shows, which the runner reads every minute.

panels.title: runner up
panels.description: UP while the runner's last write says urnetwork_proxy_test_up 1 and its heartbeat is at most 120 s old. DOWN: the last write was the clean-exit up 0, so the unit was stopped. STALE: the file still says up 1 but the heartbeat is older than 120 s; the process died or hung without its final write, and Fluent Bit keeps re-sending the last file. NO SIGNAL: nothing reached Mimir in the last 5 minutes, so the runner's host or its metrics shipping is down.

panels.title: heartbeat age
panels.description: Seconds since the runner last wrote its metrics file (urnetwork_proxy_test_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds). It writes every 15 s and after every run, and Fluent Bit reads the file every 15 s, so a healthy age stays under about 40 s. Orange from 60 s; red from 120 s: the runner is stopped, hung or crashed. Fluent Bit keeps re-sending a dead runner's last file, so this age, not the up gauge, is the liveness signal.

panels.title: runner version
panels.description: The version label of urnetwork_proxy_test_build_info, set at build time with -ldflags -X main.version. Two cards can show for up to 5 minutes after an upgrade, until the old version's series goes stale.

panels.title: proxy removes failed, last 24 h
panels.description: remove-client calls that still failed after their retries in the last 24 h (urnetwork_proxy_test_remove_failures_total). Each can leave a hosted proxy alive on the test account, where it counts toward the Pro limit of 1,000 active proxies; the runner removes its own leftovers (description starting 'proxy-test ', at most 200) only at its next start. It reads 0 while the runner reports but has not written the counter. Red from 1.

panels.title: API errors, last 24 h
panels.description: Failed runner API calls in the last 24 h, all calls together (urnetwork_proxy_test_api_errors_total: login, locations, create, remove and list). It reads 0 while the runner reports but has no error series yet. The API errors / h panel splits them by call. Orange from 1.

panels.title: setup p50, last 1 h
panels.description: Nearest-rank p50 of setup over every country's runs in the last hour, computed by the runner (urnetwork_proxy_test_all_phase_seconds_window, phase setup). Setup runs from just before the auth-client create call to the first successful request through the new proxy; only successful probes are samples. The window is in memory, so it is empty for up to an hour after a runner restart. Orange from 15 s, red from 30 s.

panels.title: setup p90, last 1 h
panels.description: Nearest-rank p90 of setup over every country's runs in the last hour, computed by the runner (urnetwork_proxy_test_all_phase_seconds_window, phase setup). Setup runs from just before the auth-client create call to the first successful request through the new proxy; only successful probes are samples. The window is in memory, so it is empty for up to an hour after a runner restart. Orange from 15 s, red from 30 s.

panels.title: connect p50, last 1 h
panels.description: Nearest-rank p50 of connect over every country's runs in the last hour, computed by the runner (urnetwork_proxy_test_all_phase_seconds_window, phase connect). Connect is Chrome's navigation start to the first byte of the page's main document, through the proxy (Navigation Timing responseStart); only navigations that succeeded with a status below 400 are samples. The window is in memory, so it is empty for up to an hour after a runner restart. Orange from 3 s, red from 10 s.

panels.title: connect p90, last 1 h
panels.description: Nearest-rank p90 of connect over every country's runs in the last hour, computed by the runner (urnetwork_proxy_test_all_phase_seconds_window, phase connect). Connect is Chrome's navigation start to the first byte of the page's main document, through the proxy (Navigation Timing responseStart); only navigations that succeeded with a status below 400 are samples. The window is in memory, so it is empty for up to an hour after a runner restart. Orange from 3 s, red from 10 s.

panels.title: success rate, last 1 h
panels.description: ok runs over all finished runs in the last hour, every country: increase() of urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total, deduplicated with max per country and outcome. Every other outcome counts against it: create_error, ready_timeout, browser_error and navigate_timeout, in which the proxy delivered nothing, and load_timeout, site_refused and http_error, in which it delivered the page's main document (see proxy delivered). It reads 0% when runs finished but none was ok, and no data when no run finished. Red below 50%, orange below 80%.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome="ok"}[1h]))) or vector(0)) / (sum(max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[1h]))) > 0)

panels.title: proxy delivered, last 1 h
panels.description: Runs in the last hour in which the page's main document came through the proxy, over all finished runs, every country: ok; load_timeout, the document came but its subresources held the load event past the navigate timeout; site_refused, the site answered 403, 429 or 451 to the exit; and http_error, any other status of 400 or more. The rest are proxy failures, in which no byte of the document came: create_error, ready_timeout, navigate_timeout and browser_error. increase() of urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total, deduplicated with max per country and outcome. It reads 0% when runs finished but none delivered, and no data when no run finished. Red below 50%, orange below 80%.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome=~"ok|load_timeout|site_refused|http_error"}[1h]))) or vector(0)) / (sum(max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[1h]))) > 0)

panels.title: countries available
panels.description: Countries in the runner's current schedule (urnetwork_proxy_test_countries): provider-locations country entries with at least one provider, refreshed every 30 minutes, or the -countries restriction. Red at 0.

panels.title: countries tested, last 24 h
panels.description: Countries with a finished run of any outcome in the last 24 h: urnetwork_proxy_test_last_run_timestamp_seconds newer than 24 h. max_over_time keeps the countries a runner tested before a restart, whose series the new process does not write until it tests them again.

targets.expr: count(max by (country) (max_over_time(urnetwork_proxy_test_last_run_timestamp_seconds{env="main"}[24h])) > time() - 86400) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: coverage, last 24 h
panels.description: Countries tested in the last 24 h over the countries in the current schedule, capped at 100% because a country that left the schedule can still count as tested. One shuffled round-robin cycle visits every country within a few hours with the default 2 workers, so below 100% after a full day means countries are skipped or their runs do not finish. Red below 80%, orange below 95%.

targets.expr: clamp_max((count(max by (country) (max_over_time(urnetwork_proxy_test_last_run_timestamp_seconds{env="main"}[24h])) > time() - 86400) or on() vector(0)) / (max(urnetwork_proxy_test_countries{env="main"}) > 0), 1)

panels.title: total providers
panels.description: Providers over every country in the latest successful read of the public provider-locations API (urnetwork_proxy_test_providers), the list the apps' location picker shows. The proxy test runner reads it every minute. A failed read keeps the last counts, and provider counts age gives their age. NO SIGNAL: no data reached the dashboard in the last 5 minutes. Red at 0.

panels.title: provider counts age
panels.description: Seconds since the runner's latest successful provider-locations read (urnetwork_proxy_test_providers_last_success_timestamp_seconds, its newest value within 7 days, so a runner restart does not blank it). The runner reads every minute and its metrics ship every 15 s, so a healthy age stays under about 90 s. A failed read keeps the last counts on every providers panel while this age grows. Orange from 5 minutes, red from 15.

panels.title: total providers over time
panels.description: Total providers over every country (urnetwork_proxy_test_providers) across the dashboard's time range; the legend gives the latest value and the minimum, mean and maximum over the range. Gaps are times the runner did not report. The history starts with the runner version that exports the counts.

panels.title: providers by country
panels.description: One row per country the public provider-locations API lists with at least one provider (urnetwork_proxy_test_country_providers, which the proxy test runner reads every minute). Every listed country has a row; scroll the table for the rest. Sorted by providers now, most first. providers now is the latest successful read; a country listed in the last 7 days but not now reads 'not listed', and so does every country while no counts arrive at all, when total providers reads NO SIGNAL. 24 h average and 7 d average are the mean counts over the last 24 hours and 7 days, and 7 d min and 7 d max are the smallest and largest counts in 7 days. They cover only the times the country was listed, since a country without a provider leaves the list. The 24 h and 7 d columns fill in as history accumulates from the deploy time of the runner version that exports these counts: until 24 hours, then 7 days, have passed since it, they cover only the time since.

panels.title: setup, connect and load p50/p90, all countries (1 h window)
panels.description: The runner's rolling 1-hour nearest-rank p50 and p90 over every country's samples, per phase (urnetwork_proxy_test_all_phase_seconds_window). setup: the create call to the first successful request through the proxy. connect: navigation start to the first byte of the main document. load: navigation start to loadEventEnd. The window is in memory; a gap follows a runner restart until new samples arrive.

panels.title: runs / h by outcome (all countries)
panels.description: Runs finished in the trailing hour by outcome over all countries: increase() of urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total, deduplicated with max per country and outcome, then summed, so a duplicate scrape or a second host never double-counts and a runner restart reads as a counter reset, not a drop. create_error: the API refused or failed the create. ready_timeout: no request through the proxy succeeded within -ready-timeout. browser_error: Chrome failed. navigate_timeout: the page did not load within -navigate-timeout. http_error: the page answered 400 or more.

panels.title: mean setup and connect by country, 1 h
panels.description: Mean phase time per country over the trailing hour: increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_seconds_total[1h]) / increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_samples_total[1h]), deduplicated with max per country and phase. Only completed phases are samples. Each country is tested about once per schedule cycle, so its line holds for the hour after each of its runs and breaks between runs; an hour without a sample is no data, not zero. Every country is drawn; hover a line to read it.

panels.title: API errors / h by call
panels.description: Failed runner API calls in the trailing hour by call (urnetwork_proxy_test_api_errors_total): login (the runner logs in again after a 401), locations, create, remove and list. 'remove failed after retries' counts the proxies the runner could not remove (urnetwork_proxy_test_remove_failures_total); each stays alive on the account until the next start's cleanup.

panels.title: per country, last 24 h
panels.description: One row per country over the last 24 h. The p50 and p90 columns are the runner's nearest-rank percentiles over that country's last 24 h of samples (urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_seconds_window); a phase without a completed sample in the window is blank, and the windows start empty after a runner restart. runs, proxy failures (create_error, ready_timeout, navigate_timeout and browser_error: no byte of the page's main document came through the proxy) and success (ok over runs) come from increase() of urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total; load_timeout, site_refused and http_error are neither. exit mismatches come from increase() of urnetwork_proxy_test_exit_country_mismatch_total: the trace's loc differed from the requested country, which is recorded but is not a failure. last tested is the time since the country's latest run of any outcome, looking back 7 days. Sorted by setup p90, slowest first.

targets.expr: sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome!~"ok|load_timeout|site_refused|http_error"}[24h]))) or (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) * 0)

(sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome="ok"}[24h]))) or (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) * 0)) / (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) > 0)

max by (country) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_exit_country_mismatch_total{env="main"}[24h])) or (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) * 0)

panels.title: slowest 20 countries by setup p90, last 24 h
panels.description: The 20 countries with the highest setup p90 over their last 24 h of samples (urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_seconds_window). A country is absent until it has a successful setup in the runner's current window, for example after a restart. Orange from 15 s, red from 30 s.

panels.title: proxy failure rate by country, last 24 h (highest 20)
panels.description: Share of each country's runs in the last 24 h in which no byte of the page's main document came through the proxy (create_error, ready_timeout, navigate_timeout and browser_error), for the 20 highest; countries without a proxy failure are not listed. load_timeout, site_refused and http_error are runs the proxy delivered, and the success-rate panel counts them against ok. A country tested only a few times reads 100% after one failure; the per-country table gives the run counts. Orange from 20%, red from 50%.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome!~"ok|load_timeout|site_refused|http_error"}[24h]))) / (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) > 0) > 0))

panels.title: fastest 20 countries by setup p90, last 24 h
panels.description: The 20 countries with the lowest setup p90 over their last 24 h of samples (urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_seconds_window), fastest first: the counterpart of the slowest 20. A country is absent until it has a successful setup in the runner's current window, for example after a restart. Orange from 15 s, red from 30 s.

panels.title: success rate by country, last 24 h (highest 20)
panels.description: Share of each country's runs in the last 24 h that ended ok, for the 20 highest: strictly ok, so a delivered page that did not load ok (load_timeout, site_refused, http_error) counts against it. Only countries with at least 3 runs in the window are ranked, so one lucky run does not read 100%; ties at the same rate are listed in no particular order, and the per-country table gives the run counts. Red under 50%, orange under 80%.

defaults.noValue: no country with 3 runs in 24 h

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(20, (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main",outcome="ok"}[24h]))) or (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) * 0)) / (sum by (country) (max by (country, outcome) (increase(urnetwork_proxy_test_runs_total{env="main"}[24h]))) >= 3)))

panels.title: latest run by country
panels.description: The newest values per country: the time since its latest run of any outcome (urnetwork_proxy_test_last_run_timestamp_seconds) and since its latest ok run (urnetwork_proxy_test_last_success_timestamp_seconds), and its latest completed create, setup, connect and load times (urnetwork_proxy_test_phase_seconds_last). Each is the newest value within 7 days, so a runner restart does not blank a country before it is tested again; a country without an ok run in 7 days reads 'none in 7 d'. A last ok far behind last tested means the country keeps failing. Sorted by last tested, stalest first.
